name: Momentum Top-3 Bond Universe + 8% Vol Target
description: Selects the top 3 assets by 12-month trailing return from the fixed-income universe (US Treasuries, USD-hedged global aggregate, global high yield, EUR govt bonds, India INR govt bonds), weights by inverse volatility, then scales to 8% annualised volatility. Rotates across duration, credit and local-currency EM rate cycles.
